### CVE-2002-2314
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2007-10-26 | Updated: 2024-09-17 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 21638: Mozilla 0.9.x/1.0 - JavaScript URL Host Spoofing Arbitrary Cookie Access (remote/multiple, 2002-07-24, verified=1)

Mozilla 1.0 allows remote attackers to steal cookies from other domains via a javascript: URL with a leading "//" and ending in a newline, which causes the host/path check to fail.

### CVE-2002-2338
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2007-10-29 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 21539: Netscape 4.x/6.x / Mozilla 0.9.x - Malformed Email POP3 Denial of Service (dos/multiple, 2002-06-12, verified=1)

The POP3 mail client in Mozilla 1.0 and earlier, and Netscape Communicator 4.7 and earlier, allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (no new mail) via a mail message containing a dot (.) at a newline, which is interpreted as the end of the message.

### CVE-2002-2359
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2007-10-29 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 21682: Mozilla 1.0/1.1 - FTP View Cross-Site Scripting (remote/unix, 2002-08-06, verified=1)

Cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the FTP view feature in Mozilla 1.0 allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via the title tag of an ftp URL.
